proposed_widenings.name: effect_menu family
proposed_widenings.justification: Thaumaturgy presents 6 named effects; the caster picks one per cast and may have up to 3 of its 1-minute effects active simultaneously. No existing spell family represents 'choose one from a named menu of effects'. The activation family uses sequential phases, not a player-choice menu. The stacking rule (up to 3 concurrently) also has no surface representation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time.

proposed_widenings.name: ability_check variant of RollKind
proposed_widenings.justification: Booming Voice grants Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. RollKind only has 'attack_roll' and 'saving_throw'. Ability checks are a third distinct resolution type required to encode this rider via the existing modify_roll_advantage effect atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks.

proposed_widenings.name: alter_object_state (for Invisible Hand)
proposed_widenings.justification: Invisible Hand deterministically changes the state of an environmental object (door/window open or closed). The v4 atom 'object' exists as an attachment kind, but there is no effect atom for altering an object's state. The other cosmetic effects (Altered Eyes, Fire Play, Tremors, Phantom Sound) are dm_agenda per ARCHITECTURE.md and require no new atoms.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut.

notes: Thaumaturgy does not fit any existing spell family. The dominant gap is structural: the 'choose one of N named effects' pattern (with a concurrent-stack limit of 3) has no surface representation. The activation family is sequential phases, not a player menu. Secondarily, Booming Voice requires 'ability_check' in RollKind (surface widening). Five of the six effects are cosmetic/narrative (out-of-core per ARCHITECTURE.md); Invisible Hand is the edge case with a deterministic object-state change but no matching effect atom. No Dhall or JSON authored.
